prompt.es: Escribe tu réplica: dos concesiones, dos contraargumentos y tono cortés.

answer.text: Dear Tom, thank you for your post. I take your point about sleep, and I would not deny that many teenagers are tired in the morning. Nonetheless, I do not think a later start is the best answer. First, the evidence is not clear: one school changed its timetable, but the grades stayed the same. With respect, one example is not enough to change every school. Second, while a later start could help students sleep, it would also end the day later. Many students have sports, jobs or lessons after school, and their parents cannot always collect them. Buses would also need new timetables, and that would cost the council more money. I agree that students should rest, but perhaps the school could start a little later, at half past eight, and keep the day the same length. In conclusion, I accept that sleep matters, yet I believe a smaller change would solve the problem without creating new ones. Best wishes, Ana

Hello Tom, thanks for your message. It is true that teenagers need more sleep, and I admit that early lessons are hard for many of us. That said, I am not convinced that ten o'clock is the right time. The survey in your post comes from one school only. With respect, the evidence from a single class cannot decide the question for every student. Also, while a later start might help some students, it would make the afternoon longer. Parents who work early cannot always bring their children to school, and the buses would have to change. I take your point, but I think we should try a smaller change first. For example, the school could start at half past eight for one month and then check the grades. In conclusion, I would not reject your idea, but I would test it carefully before changing every timetable. Kind regards, Ana

feedback.es: Una buena réplica concede dos puntos con fórmulas distintas, rebate cada uno con evidencia concreta, suaviza el desacuerdo con with respect y cierra con una conclusión.

origin.text: Un compañero publica en el blog del colegio: «Las clases deberían empezar a las diez. Los adolescentes duermen poco, sacan mejores notas si descansan y llegan más contentos.» Escribe una réplica de 180 a 230 palabras en inglés: concede dos de sus puntos, rebate dos con evidencia, mantén un tono cortés y cierra con una conclusión.
